newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Okocim and Stalexport closed lower while Animex closed higher in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Monday.
Elektrim, Stomil Olsztyn and Universal were flat and the other nine stocks did not trade.
Turnover was at 1.7 million zlotys, down from Thursday's 2.8 million zlotys. Markets were closed on Friday for All Saints Day.
NFI units fell 3.8 percent to 140 zlotys.
